dict.string: Observer records your microphone so it can capture your side of the meeting and transcribe it on this Mac.
Observer transcribes meetings on-device using Apple Speech. Audio is not sent to Apple or Observer servers.
Observer uses your calendar to show what’s up next and to match live meetings to scheduled events. Choose which calendars to subscribe to in Settings. Calendar access is optional.

Observer captures meeting audio from apps like Zoom or Meet so it can transcribe other participants locally.
Observer captures the meeting window and system audio. Nothing is uploaded; recordings stay on this Mac.
